name: Plume USD
oneLiner: pUSD is Plume's dollar stablecoin minted 1:1 against USDC in a Nucleus BoringVault; zero-fee redemption on Ethereum or Plume Chain with OFAC compliance checks.
collateral: 1:1 backed by USDC deposited into a Nucleus BoringVault
pegMechanism: Zero-fee mint/redeem at 1:1 for USDC on Ethereum or Plume Chain; reserves managed by Nucleus BoringVault contracts with OFAC compliance checks

applicabilityBasis.summary: pUSD is a non-interest-bearing USDC wrapper with payment-like use on Plume Chain. The legal issuer is Nest, a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, and the token explicitly restricts U.S. persons from minting. Whether secondary-market access or the payment use case brings it within GENIUS Act scope remains unresolved in proposed rulemaking.

genius.notes: pUSD is issued by Nest (Marshall Islands DAO LLC, LEI 254900BB9T1QYAT04892), not Plume directly. Plume manages the underlying BoringVault infrastructure. The token explicitly excludes U.S. persons from minting per Nest/Plume product documentation and RWA.xyz eligibility listing (Non-U.S. Investors only). No GENIUS authorization has been sought. Applicability remains unclear because secondary-market exposure to U.S. persons is possible and the GENIUS Act's foreign-issuer scope is still being defined in NPRMs.

controls.label: BoringVault Safe owner (3-of-6)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295054 (2026-06-11), owner() on pUSD BoringVault (0xdddd73f5df1f0dc31373357beac77545dc5a6f3f) returned 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982. getOwners()=[6 addresses], threshold()=3. getModulesPaginated returned 0 modules. masterCopy slot0=0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea (GnosisSafeL2). BoringVault has no proxy admin (non-upgradeable). Same owner confirmed on Plume block 74171616. authority()=0x97bc6151fc501e6e2ec2acba3d4261d4bc7a6f90 (RolesAuthority) on both chains; RolesAuthority owner = same Safe.

controls.label: Nucleus Teller (Plume deposit gateway)
controls.evidence: At Plume block 74171811 (2026-06-11), live mint transactions (e.g. 0xcf58692fa0f5…) showed callers invoking 0x41bdb4aa4a63a5b2efc531858d3118392b1a1c3d (Teller, 2304 bytes) which in turn triggered Transfer-from-zero on the BoringVault. The Teller is the OFAC-gated predicate proxy deposit gateway; RolesAuthority owned by same 3-of-6 Safe controls which addresses can call enter().

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531116 and Plume block 81049017 (2026-07-14), the pUSD BoringVault at 0xdddd… has zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots on both tracked deployments, confirming an immutable mint-critical vault. owner() remains the 3-of-6 GnosisSafeL2 at 0xa08a… with no enabled modules; authority() remains RolesAuthority 0x97bc…, owned by the same Safe. The Plume Teller at 0x41bdb4aa remains the deposit gateway and is the only reviewed direct mint route.
